facts.fact: GIMTEL launched interconnection of bank apps and e-wallets under the Central Bank of Mauritania's strategy, and its governor said oversight of payment systems had been activated.

systems.platform: interbank switch for bank apps and e-wallets
systems.tiers: BreadCash, Bamis Digital, BCI Pay, Bankili, Amanti, Sedad, Qlik joined; others in testing

MRT.note: Nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: GIMTEL officially launched interconnection between bank applications and e-wallets, with BreadCash, Bamis Digital, BCI Pay, Bankili, Amanti, Sedad and Qlik already joined.
GIMTEL's launched interconnection links national bank apps and e-wallets in one system, with further providers in technical testing.

systems.platform: interbank switch for bank apps and e-wallets

MRT.note: Nothing on tax or fee payment.
